title: Cron field expansion
description: Implement expand_field(spec, lo, hi). Return the sorted list of unique ints matched by a cron-style field. spec is a str of comma-separated items. An item is '*' (every value lo..hi), 'N' (one value), or 'A-B' (inclusive range), each optionally followed by '/S' (step). '*/S' gives lo, lo+S, ... up to hi; 'A-B/S' steps from A up to B; 'N/S' means N, N+S, ... up to hi. Every value must satisfy lo <= v <= hi, else ValueError. A step must be a positive integer (0, negative, empty or non-numeric steps raise ValueError). A > B raises ValueError. An empty spec or any empty item (',1', '1,,2', '1,') raises ValueError. Numbers are plain ASCII digits only ('+1', '1.5', ' 1', '-1' raise ValueError). A non-str spec raises TypeError.
invariants: '*/15' over 0..59 is [0, 15, 30, 45]; '5/20' over 0..59 is [5, 25, 45] (a bare N with a step runs to hi).
'1-5/2' is [1, 3, 5]; steps never go past the range end B.
The result is sorted and has no duplicates ('5,1,5-6' over 0..10 is [1, 5, 6]).
Out-of-range values, zero or malformed steps, reversed ranges and empty items raise ValueError.
Only the first '-' splits a range, so '1-2-3' is invalid.
